---
title: "Dorian ♭2"
subtitle: "Alternate Soundtracks"
---

This collection of alternate soundtracks was originally created as an assignment for **VM402-09 Soundtracks: Music & Audiovisual Media**, a course taught at Emerson College in Spring 2019. The assignment asks students to replace the original soundtrack of a film or video with a different piece of music, exploring the relationship between music and the moving image.

The concept examines how different musical pieces can fundamentally transform our perception of visual media. By juxtaposing surprising musical choices against existing footage, we discover that meaning is not fixed but emerges from the interplay of sight and sound.

The first two videos shown were produced as demos for the assignment. Additional examples have been added, including student-made music videos and established works that exemplify the alternate-soundtrack concept—demonstrating that this creative practice extends far beyond the classroom into contemporary artistic practice.
